review_scope: Complete436-line backend article read, including Docker/systemd/Compose and all five SDK language examples. Unsafe/incomplete snippets are reference evidence, not instructions; diagram assets are separately unreviewed. No build/download/process launch/network exposure/token/environment change/deletion/publication performed. No accepted policy, native proof, rights clearance or independent omission certification.
